19,279 reviews. 4.5 stars. And most tourists still haven't heard of Hòn Thơm.

The Sunworld Hon Thom Cable Car stretches over open ocean to reach an island water park. The cable car station is built to look like Ancient Rome. It sounds ridiculous. It works completely.

Beaches on one side. Slides and pools on the other. One ticket covers both.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Watch the ocean drop away beneath you as the cable car pulls you toward Hòn Thơm island. Ancient Rome architecture, water park, beach, all on one island. Phu Quoc delivers weird and wonderful in equal measure.
